summary: Field-level redaction mapping and legal-basis tagging for EU banking audit - evidence & export profile request
description: Issue summary: Customer (EuroBank Holdings, enterprise) requests a signed evidence package and SIEM export profile that demonstrates per-field redaction decisions together with attached legal-basis tags (e.g., consent, contract, legitimate_interest) and consent timestamps for EU-region tenant activity. Impact: This is a compliance block for an upcoming regulator audit (scheduled 2026-03-20) — customer needs proof of how PII was redacted, which legal basis applied to each record, and a cryptographically signed manifest for delivered artifacts. Environment: prod, eu-west region, single-tenant on Redwood Dedicated. Request: 1) A sample export (CSV and Parquet) for a 7-day slice (2026-02-28 to 2026-03-06) showing pseudonymized identifiers and the redaction_reason field per event; 2) A mapping document describing the redaction rules applied (field name -> rule id -> redaction level); 3) Per-record legal_basis tags and consent timestamps where available; 4) Signed delivery manifest (SHA256) and an RFC3161 timestamp of manifest creation; 5) A short runbook describing how to reproduce the same export via the Console or API, including parameter names and recommended query filters.
steps_to_reproduce: Customer reproduction intent: query audit stream for tenant eurobank-prod between 2026-02-28T00:00:00Z and 2026-03-06T23:59:59Z with fields: event_id, timestamp, actor_id, resource_id, changes, redaction_reason, legal_basis, consent_timestamp.
If export fails: capture exporter logs and console export job id, share with Support for investigation.
logs: Customer-provided sample (anonymized): event_id=evt_01ab, timestamp=2026-03-02T14:12:03Z, actor_id=usr_xxxxx, resource_id=doc_9a8b, redaction_reason=phone_mask, legal_basis=consent, consent_timestamp=2025-11-12T09:22:11Z

Redaction engine trace: 2026-03-11T08:45:25Z WARN rule_lookup_timeout for field 'consent_timestamp' fallback=empty
comments: Aisha Patel (Customer Success) 2026-03-10: Received audit request from EuroBank compliance lead (Sofia Lind). They specifically require legal_basis per event and proof that consent timestamps are retained when present. Audit date is 2026-03-20, asking for deliverables by 2026-03-13.

Evelyn Chen (Support) 2026-03-10: Acknowledged. Started triage to verify export feature flags and whether redaction metadata is included by default. Investigating exporter job behaviour in eu-west cluster.

SRE on-call (Marcus Lee) 2026-03-11: Confirmed exporter runs in dedicated pool for eurobank-prod. Found recent rollout of redaction-engine v1.9.2 on 2026-03-09 — noting a change that can omit optional metadata fields when rule backend times out.

Evelyn Chen 2026-03-11: Requested permission to run a controlled re-export and provide a signed manifest. Proposed approach: create export snapshot, pseudonymize actor_id/resource_id with salted HMAC, include redaction_reason and legal_basis columns, sign manifest with platform signing key and attach RFC3161 timestamp. Asked customer to confirm acceptance of salted HMAC pseudonymization as proof artifact.

Sofia Lind (Customer) 2026-03-11: Confirmed salted HMAC pseudonymization is acceptable provided we include mapping of hashing salt fingerprint and that the legal_basis and consent_timestamp are present as separate columns. Also asked for a short statement of chain-of-custody for the delivered artifact.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Recent redaction-engine update introduced a race condition with the rule backend (rules-service) leading to missing redaction_reason/legal_basis values when rule lookup exceeds 250ms timeout.
Hypothesis 2: Exporter configuration for dedicated tenants had include_meta defaulted to false for performance; need to verify tenant config override for eurobank-prod.

Checks performed: 1) Reviewed export job logs (job_id=exp-7890) and saw WARN for rule_lookup_timeout. 2) Checked tenant config: export.include_meta = false (inherited from global defaults) for eurobank-prod. 3) Validated rules-service latency spikes around 2026-03-09 due to cache miss after rollout.

Partial finding: When rules-service returns late, exporter records an empty value for redaction metadata instead of retrying or marking record for manual review. This explains missing column in customer sample export.
resolution_notes: Planned immediate workaround: run a controlled replay export with exporter param include_meta=true and increased rule_lookup_timeout=1000ms for the requested 7-day slice; pseudonymize identifiers via HMAC-salt provided by Support; generate SHA256 manifest and request RFC3161 timestamp from our timestamping service.

Planned follow-up engineering fix: create a patch to make exporter tolerate rule lookup timeouts by queueing records for async metadata enrichment and include a manifest flag 'metadata_partial=false' to fail exports that would otherwise omit redaction metadata. Triage ticket created: INT-33421.
Deliverable timeline: Controlled export + signed manifest to customer by 2026-03-13. Engineering patch targeted for 2026-03-20 with rollout to prod-eu after validation.
